title: Rational design of stapled helical peptides as antidiabetic PPARgamma antagonists to target coactivator site by decreasing unfavorable entropy penalty instead of increasing favorable enthalpy contribution.
authors: Zhang, Yang; Wang, Jie; Li, Wenchao; Guo, Ying
one_liner_zh: 该文通过MD模拟与能量学分析理性设计订书肽，靶向PPARγ共激活因子位点以阻断蛋白-DNA/蛋白互作，虽非TF-DNA体系但涉及转录因子PPARγ的互作界面与动态机制，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor gamma (PPARgamma) is a ligand-activated transcription factor belonging to the nuclear hormone receptor and has been exploited as a well-established druggable target for the treatment of diabetes mellitus (DM). Traditionally, small-molecule compounds have been developed to attack at the ligand site and Ser273 phosphorylation site of PPARgamma. In this study, we derived helical peptide segments from the LXXLL motif region of coactivator proteins as antidiabetic PPARgamma antagonists, which were expected to competitively disrupt the native interaction between PPARgamma and its cognate coactivators by rebinding at PPARgamma coactivator site. Structural analysis, dynamics simulation and energetics dissection revealed that these peptides cannot be well folded into active helical structure when splitting from the protein context of their parent coactivators and exhibit a large flexibility and intrinsic disorder in the free state, which would, therefore, incur a considerable entropy penalty upon rebinding to PPARgamma. Hydrocarbon stapling strategy was employed to constrain these free coactivator peptides into ordered helical conformation, thus largely minimizing unfavorable entropy penalty but having only a moderate effect on favorable enthalpy contribution. The computational findings were further substantiated by fluorescence-based assays; the binding affinity of three potent SRC1, NCoA6 and p300 coactivator peptides to PPARgamma was observed to be improved by 7.2-fold, 4.2-fold and 5.7-fold upon the stapling, which were also measured to have an efficient competitive potency with their unstapled counterparts for PPARgamma coactivator site, with CC(50) = 0.096, 0.12 and 0.18 muM, respectively.
abstract_zh: 过氧化物酶体增殖物激活受体γ（PPARgamma）是一种配体激活的转录因子，属于核激素受体家族，并已被开发为治疗糖尿病（DM）的成熟药物靶点。传统上，小分子化合物被设计用于攻击PPARgamma的配体位点和Ser273磷酸化位点。在本研究中，我们从共激活蛋白的LXXLL基序区域衍生出螺旋肽段，作为抗糖尿病的PPARgamma拮抗剂，预期通过重新结合于PPARgamma共激活位点，竞争性破坏PPARgamma与其同源共激活因子之间的天然相互作用。结构分析、动力学模拟和能量学解析表明，这些肽段在从其亲本共激活蛋白的蛋白质环境中分离后，无法良好折叠成活性螺旋结构，在自由状态下表现出较大的灵活性和内在无序性，因此，在重新结合PPARgamma时会产生显著的熵惩罚。采用烃链钉扎策略将这些自由共激活肽段约束为有序螺旋构象，从而大幅减少不利的熵惩罚，但对有利的焓贡献仅有中等影响。计算发现进一步通过基于荧光的实验得到证实；三种强效SRC1、NCoA6和p300共激活肽段与PPARgamma的结合亲和力在钉扎后分别提高了7.2倍、4.2倍和5.7倍，同时测得它们对PPARgamma共激活位点具有高效的竞争效力，其CC(50)值分别为0.096、0.12和0.18 μM。
